Question: Jack and Jill are going swimming at a pool that is one mile from their house. They leave home simultaneously. Jill rides her bicycle to the pool at a constant speed of \(10\) miles per hour. Jack walks to the pool at a constant speed of \(4\) miles per hour. How many minutes before Jack does Jill arrive?
